request: Rank the 4 best Audi R8 generations overall across the full production run. Use 4 different generations when available, with one representative version from each generation. If the model has fewer than 4 true generations, use the most important era-defining versions across its history.
title: BEST AUDI R8 GENERATIONS
close_narration: So, would you choose the raw charm of the first-gen R8 or the modern prowess of the second-gen V10?
order_rationale: Ranked by weighted enthusiast desirability, driving engagement, historical significance, performance, collectibility, and value—not chronology.

entries.name: R8 V10 Plus
entries.label: PLUS PERFORMANCE

entries.ranking_case: Renowned for its upgraded track performance and design, this R8 captured the essence of speed and style.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $260K.

entries.name: R8 GT
entries.label: TRACK FOCUSED
entries.one_line_fact: Then there's the R8 GT, a limited edition from 2011 with just 333 units made. It's sleek with a track-focused design and a carbon fiber spoiler. Sporting 560 horsepower, it originally cost $196.8K. Now, it's a unique find valued around $100K.
entries.ranking_case: Its racing spirit and limited production make this a desirable option for enthusiasts seeking high performance and rarity.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $100K.

entries.name: First-Gen R8 V8
entries.label: FIRST ICONIC
entries.one_line_fact: The first-gen R8 V8 from 2006 was Audi's first ever supercar. With 420 horsepower, it set the benchmark for others to follow. It started at $109K, showcasing iconic side blades and a mid-engine layout. Appreciating in value, examples can fetch $140K today.
entries.ranking_case: This original R8 set the tone for Audi's luxury sports cars with its distinctive design and driving experience.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $140K.

entries.name: Second-Gen R8 V10
entries.label: V10 POWERHOUSE
entries.one_line_fact: And at the top, the second-gen R8 V10 launched in 2016. It’s a true powerhouse with 540 horsepower. Originally $162.9K, it redefined Audi’s performance image. The sharp side blades and honeycomb grille scream style and speed—an instant classic.
entries.ranking_case: The V10 model elevated performance with a naturally aspirated engine, defining modern Audi excitement.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $150K.
